title.narrative: Resilience and Food Security for women through Production, Productivity and Markets in Mauritania (2P2M)
Resilienza e sicurezza alimentare delle donne attraverso la produzione, la produttività e i mercati in Mauritania (2P2M)

description.narrative: Il progetto 2P2M cofinanzia il Sahel Joint Programme in Response to the Challenges of COVID-19, Conflict and Climate Change (SD3C), un programma regionale che coinvolge i cinque paesi del G5 Sahel (Burkina Faso, Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Ciad) e il Senegal, attuato dalle tre agenzie ONU del polo romano. L’obiettivo generale è quello di rafforzare la resilienza delle donne rurali più vulnerabili nella regione del Sahel in modo sostenibile, al fine di mitigare gli effetti della crisi COVID-19, dei conflitti e del cambiamento climatico. L’obiettivo specifico del progetto 2P2M è quello di rafforzare i mezzi di sussistenza dei piccoli produttori e in particolare delle donne e dei giovani che vivono nelle zone transfrontaliere. Il progetto si rivolgerà a 900 famiglie e a circa 5.450 donne e giovani beneficiari per un periodo di due anni, con particolare attenzione ai gruppi più vulnerabili e all’adozione di pratiche di produzione sostenibile e di approcci di coesione sociale. Il programma è strutturato in due componenti tecniche e una componente di coordinamento. Componente 1: Aumentare la produttività e la produzione agroforestale attraverso pratiche e tecnologie agricole resilienti al cambiamento climatico. Le attività si concentreranno sul miglioramento del capitale produttivo e della resilienza, sul rafforzamento delle capacità e sul peace building. Componente 2: Integrazione economica attraverso interventi volti a rafforzare i mercati transfrontalieri e a rendere sicure le transazioni di confine, anche attraverso l’uso di servizi finanziari digitali. Tutte le attività pianificate pongono un’enfasi speciale sulle questioni di genere e sui giovani. La componente 3 è dedicata al dialogo politico, alla gestione e al coordinamento del progetto. Il progetto fornisce soluzioni coordinate e pragmatiche su aspetti tecnici e politici che saranno implementati attraverso (i) il focus geografico specifico sulle aree transfrontaliere, (ii) la dimensione transfrontaliera delle attività e la risoluzione dei conflitti tra agricoltori e pastori, e (iii) il forte partenariato con il Segretariato del G5 Sahel, che presiede il comitato di pilotaggio del SD3C a livello regionale. La gestione dell’iniziativa sarà condivisa con un altro progetto finanziato dall’IFAD (PROGRES) che, sotto la supervisione del Ministero dello Sviluppo Rurale, sarà chiamato a garantire il coordinamento e la gestione del programma, sia per la supervisione istituzionale, il comitato di pilotaggio e il coordinamento operativo.

The 2P2M project co-finances the Sahel Joint Programme in Response to the Challenges of COVID-19, Conflict and Climate Change (SD3C), a regional programme involving the five G5 Sahel countries (Burkina Faso, Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Chad) and Senegal, implemented by the three UN agencies of the Rome-based hub. The overall objective is to strengthen the resilience of the most vulnerable rural women in the Sahel region in a sustainable manner, in order to mitigate the effects of the COVID-19 crisis, conflicts, and climate change. The specific objective of the 2P2M project is to strengthen the livelihoods of small-scale producers, particularly women and young people living in cross-border areas. The project will target 900 families and approximately 5,450 women and young beneficiaries over a two-year period, with particular attention to the most vulnerable groups and the adoption of sustainable production practices and social cohesion approaches. The programme is structured into two technical components and one coordination component. Component 1: Increasing agroforestry productivity and production through climate-resilient agricultural practices and technologies. Activities will focus on improving productive assets and resilience, capacity strengthening, and peacebuilding. Component 2: Economic integration through interventions aimed at strengthening cross-border markets and securing border transactions, including through the use of digital financial services. All planned activities place special emphasis on gender issues and youth. Component 3 is dedicated to policy dialogue, project management, and coordination. The project provides coordinated and pragmatic solutions on technical and policy aspects, which will be implemented through (i) the specific geographic focus on cross-border areas, (ii) the cross-border nature of activities and the resolution of conflicts between farmers and herders, and (iii) the strong partnership with the G5 Sahel Secretariat, which chairs the steering committee of the SD3C at the regional level. The management of the initiative will be shared with another project financed by IFAD (PROGRES), which, under the supervision of the Ministry of Rural Development, will ensure programme coordination and management, including institutional oversight, the steering committee, and operational coordination.

tag.narrative: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls

By 2030, build the resilience of the poor and those in vulnerable situations and reduce their exposure and vulnerability to climate-related extreme events and other economic, social and environmental shocks and disasters

By 2030, double the agricultural productivity and incomes of small-scale food producers, in particular women, indigenous peoples, family farmers, pastoralists and fishers, including through secure and equal access to land, other productive resources and inputs, knowledge, financial services, markets and opportunities for value addition and non-farm employment

By 2030, ensure sustainable food production systems and implement resilient agricultural practices that increase productivity and production, that help maintain ecosystems, that strengthen capacity for adaptation to climate change, extreme weather, drought, flooding and other disasters and that progressively improve land and soil quality

By 2030, ensure that all men and women, in particular the poor and the vulnerable, have equal rights to economic resources, as well as access to basic services, ownership and control over land and other forms of property, inheritance, natural resources, appropriate new technology and financial services, including microfinance
End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture
End poverty in all its forms everywhere
Enhance the use of enabling technology, in particular information and communications technology, to promote the empowerment of women
Ensure women’s full and effective participation and equal opportunities for leadership at all levels of decision-making in political, economic and public life

Increase investment, including through enhanced international cooperation, in rural infrastructure, agricultural research and extension services, technology development and plant and livestock gene banks in order to enhance agricultural productive capacity in developing countries, in particular least developed countries
